quarterly_data.quarter: Kanto Denka Kogyo results presentation: Business Results for the First Quarter of FY Ending March 31, 2027 (08-10-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Specialty gases for semiconductors: sales rose on higher volumes supported by improved operating rates and price revisions; WF6 production continues by diversifying its tungsten procurement sources. The first-half operating profit forecast was raised on specialty-gas price revisions despite higher raw material and fuel prices; full-year projections from Q2 on are kept unchanged while the impact of raw material and fuel prices is reviewed.
quarterly_data.figure: Specialty gases (non-consolidated) net sales 14.3 billion yen vs 10.3; operating profit 4.2 vs 0.7; H1 operating profit forecast 6.6 billion yen vs 5.3 initial
